product_metadata.title: Exclusivo Mezcla Lightweight Reversible 2-Piece Comforter Set All Seasons, Down Alternative Comforter with 1 Pillow Sham, Twin Size, Dusty Teal/Spa Blue
features: WHAT YOU CAN GET: The 2-piece comforter set includes one twin comforter 68"W x 88"L and one matching envelope pillow sham 20"W x 26"L. Note: The comforter set comes in vacuum-sealed package, please expose it to sunlight and tap it gently after receiving it, it will puff up to its original size quickly and be fluffy nicely after hours.

PREMIUM MATERIAL: 100% brushed microfiber fabric on both sides makes the comforter breathable, skin-friendly and noiseless, easy to fall asleep. 220GSM polyester down alternative filling provides you enough warmth, softness and comfort all night and all year round. The comforters are lightweight but warm enough for all seasons. It can be used as a comforter set for twin bed or as a twin duvet insert.
EXQUISITE STITCHING: Neat square stitching prevents the filling from shifting and clumping together in one area, keeps the shape of the comforter even after washing.

PERFECT HOME DECOR: The reversible comforter set features double-side design, top side is dusty teal and back side is spa blue. Such ingenious designed comforter would match your various bedroom decoration better and offer you an elegant and classic feeling. It is decorative that could be suitable for bedroom, kid’s room, guest room, RV and vocation room. It is also an ideal gift for your family and friends on Father's Day, Mother's Day, Birthday, Christmas, New Year or Back to School.
EASY CARE: Machine washable and dryable. Wash in cold water and tumble dry low in machine which can take a load of min 7 KG or sun-dry.
